g.text: Actual equipment identity, power limits, enable behavior and physical fit remain unverified.

g.desc: Actual equipment identity, power limits, enable behavior and physical fit remain unverified.

g.text: J1/J2: male pins on underside; numbering describes top-view socket rows. Confirm orientation mechanically.

g.desc: J1/J2: male pins on underside; numbering describes top-view socket rows. Confirm orientation mechanically.

g.text: VM contact physically omitted: J2 begins at host GND below VM. Board uses only 5 V from VCC_IO.

g.desc: VM contact physically omitted: J2 begins at host GND below VM. Board uses only 5 V from VCC_IO.

g.text: U1: inverting open-drain outputs. Input HIGH sinks the corresponding MINUS terminal; LOW releases it.

g.desc: U1: inverting open-drain outputs. Input HIGH sinks the corresponding MINUS terminal; LOW releases it.

g.text: 5 V input profile only: U1 VIH >= 0.7 x VCC. This candidate does not support unbuffered 3.3 V sources.

g.desc: 5 V input profile only: U1 VIH >= 0.7 x VCC. This candidate does not support unbuffered 3.3 V sources.

g.text: Do not apply 24 V to J3. Verify EN disable polarity, startup, loaded edge timing and host 5 V rail before release.

g.desc: Do not apply 24 V to J3. Verify EN disable polarity, startup, loaded edge timing and host 5 V rail before release.

g.text: No isolation or hardware safety function. Alarm wiring remains separate. ERC is not physical validation.

g.desc: No isolation or hardware safety function. Alarm wiring remains separate. ERC is not physical validation.

g.text: Provisional profile: Octopus Pro V1.0 F429/F446, 5 V buffered socket signals; CL57T V4.1 in 5 V mode.

g.desc: Provisional profile: Octopus Pro V1.0 F429/F446, 5 V buffered socket signals; CL57T V4.1 in 5 V mode.

g.text: Input bias: STEP / DIR low; EN high when source is high impedance.

g.desc: Input bias: STEP / DIR low; EN high when source is high impedance.

g.text: J3.1 fans out to PUL+, DIR+, ENA+.

g.text: No motor power on this connector.
